scientific_integrity: Explicit full-section calculation and exact rational inequality; finite numerical tests supplementary; no maximal-direction characterization; no general conjecture proof; historical overlap risk remains.
scientific_limitations: The strict comparison is only for the affinely circular double-cone family in dimension three.
The all-dimensional closed form is for one transformed bisector direction, not the supremum over all directions.
Published 2011 related cone research was compared at abstract level only.
title: Bisector sections of affine double cones and a strict section-root gap
